title: Remote viewing of 'moksha' finds a soul-trapping energy-extraction system left from an ancient solar-system war

tellings.quote: and that it is part of a vast machinery of energy extraction which was set up in our solar system at the end of a war that devastated the solar system.

tellings.difference: Told firsthand, describing the target as a fence, grid or cage around a planet, with no mention of the ancient war.

as_told.title: Remote viewer describes the moksha target as a grid and cage around a planet

plain: A man named Scott Turner says he did a remote viewing session, a trained attempt to see hidden things with the mind alone, aimed at "moksha", the release of the soul that Indian religions teach about, and found a fence, grid or cage around a planet. The philosopher Jason Jorjani, passing on what Turner told him, gives it a bigger meaning: the grid traps souls and is "part of a vast machinery of energy extraction which was set up in our solar system at the end of a war that devastated the solar system." Turner himself, telling it firsthand, describes only the fence or grid and does not mention the ancient war.
